ai_summary: A Supreme Court ruling has upheld previous decisions on permanent establishment (PE) and transfer pricing in international taxation. title: Income Tax | DVO Valuation Reports Furnished After Six Months Cannot Justify Section 263 Revision: ITAT Raipur
summary: ITAT Raipur quashes Section 263 revisions based on DVO reports received beyond six months under Section 142A and unaddressed valuation objections. The post DVO Valuation Reports Furnished After Six Months Cannot Justify Section 263 Revision: ITAT Raipur appeared first on TaxGuru .
ai_summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) Raipur has quashed Section 263 revisions that were based on Departmental Valuation Officer (DVO) reports. The tribunal ruled that DVO reports received beyond the statutory six-month period under Section 142A, and with unaddressed valuation objections, cannot justify such revisions.

title: Income Tax | Reassessment Based on Change of Opinion Invalid: SC Declines to Interfere With Gujarat HC Judgment

ai_summary: The Supreme Court of India has dismissed the Revenue's Special Leave Petition, declining to interfere with a Gujarat High Court judgment. The High Court had quashed a reassessment initiated under Section 148, ruling it invalid if based solely on a change of opinion.

title: Income Tax | ITAT Delhi Deletes ₹5.02 Crore Royalty Adjustment Based on Unexecuted Franchise Agreements
summary: ITAT Delhi deletes ELCA’s royalty adjustment, allows RSU, IT and promotion expenses, and directs verification of loss and depreciation set-off. The post ITAT Delhi Deletes ₹5.02 Crore Royalty Adjustment Based on Unexecuted Franchise Agreements appeared first on TaxGuru .
ai_summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) Delhi has deleted a ₹5.02 Crore royalty adjustment for ELCA, finding it was based on unexecuted franchise agreements. The tribunal also allowed various expenses and directed verification for loss and depreciation set-off, highlighting the importance of legally binding agreements for royalty payments.

title: Income Tax | AMP Expenses Not International Transaction Without Evidence of Arrangement: ITAT Delhi
summary: ITAT Delhi upholds deletion of Bacardi’s AMP transfer pricing adjustments for AYs 2014-15 and 2015-16; cross-objections dismissed as infructuous. The post AMP Expenses Not International Transaction Without Evidence of Arrangement: ITAT Delhi appeared first on TaxGuru .
ai_summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) Delhi has upheld the deletion of Bacardi's Advertising, Marketing, and Promotion (AMP) transfer pricing adjustments for Assessment Years 2014-15 and 2015-16. The tribunal ruled that AMP expenses do not constitute an international transaction without clear evidence of an underlying arrangement.

title: Income Tax | AO Cannot Reject Slump Sale Valuation Without Identifying Defects: ITAT Delhi
summary: Delhi ITAT upholds deletion of ₹4 crore slump sale addition where AO failed to identify valuation defects under Section 50B. The post AO Cannot Reject Slump Sale Valuation Without Identifying Defects: ITAT Delhi appeared first on TaxGuru .
